title: Code R
overview:
I want to keep watching you as you keep on driving...

Code R is a racing adventure that pairs a romance story with real-time 3D mountain pass racing. You grew up with your father in the family bicycle shop after losing your mother as a child. When you discover a savings account she left in your name, you withdraw the money without asking and buy your dream car, a Fairlady Z - much to your family's dismay.

Get around town on the map, take part-time jobs, meet rivals and go on dates with the girls in your life, then take to the mountain roads to race. Winning earns money and reputation, but damage costs money to fix, so manage your funds for repairs and upgrades and tune your car's settings in detail.

- Story-driven adventure with real-time 3D races
- Car damage, repairs, upgrades and detailed tuning
- Part-time jobs and dates around town
- Racing Controller and Sega Multi Controller compatible

走り続けるあなたを見ていたい…
